title: Forgotten Skies
description:
Discover the mysteries of Forgotten Skies, a fun platforming adventure and embark on an odyssey through the mysteries where ancient secrets and hidden dangers await in this captivating adventure game. Forgotten Skies invites you on an incredible journey into a world of mystery and adventure and fascinating unique creatures. Prepare for a journey filled with challenging missions, and quirky quests in this intriguing adventure!

• Discover a beautifully world with many interesting characters and quests
• Find collectibles and gather ressources
• Balance and guide your character in a funny but challenging platformer
• Explore an intriguing Storyline with many missions and background lore

Meet and discover a variety of entertaining characters and take on a exciting of quests and challenges. In addition to fun storylines and missions, you will also encounter hostile creatures that you will have to battle on your adventures.
Forgotten Skies is full of dark creatures, mystic beasts and vicious bandits.

Forgotten Skies combines classic platform gameplay with acrobatic jumping and balance controls, and a fun adventure game with big storylines, missions and a world of exploration.
